The '''"Mercy" grenade''' was a model of [[Gas grenade/Legends|gas grenade]] manufactured by [[Goseia Heavy Industries Concern/Legends|Goseia Heavy Industries Concern]]. It was also called the '''nightmare grenade''' as it emitted an hallucinogenic [[Gas/Legends|gas]] that distorted perceptions, provoked intense visual illusions, impaired memory and created feelings of paranoia and dread. The effects of the gas on [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] varied widely.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
